# v2.40-dev Release Notes

## Mobile-friendly navigation and layout

Training Tracker now works properly on a phone. The app was built desktop-first,
so on a small screen the navigation sidebar permanently ate into the page and a
few tables and dialogs didn't fit. This release adds a mobile navigation drawer
and tidies up the layout so the app is usable on the go — with **no change to how
anything works on a desktop**.

### What's new

- **Slide-in navigation drawer on small screens.** Below the tablet breakpoint
  the sidebar is now hidden and replaced by a **☰ menu button** in the top bar.
  Tapping it slides the full navigation in from the left over a dimmed backdrop;
  tapping a link, the ✕, or the backdrop closes it again. On larger screens
  nothing changes — the docked sidebar (and its collapse toggle) works exactly as
  before.
- **Roomier content on phones.** Page padding is reduced on small screens, and
  page headers now wrap instead of colliding when a title and its controls don't
  fit on one line.

### Fixed

- **Admin tables no longer clip their controls on mobile.** The Users list (and
  several other admin tables) could hide their row-action buttons off the right
  edge with no way to scroll to them. Those tables now scroll horizontally so
  every control is reachable. The Training detail and Offerings dashboard tables
  got the same treatment.
- **Dialogs fit the screen.** Tall pop-up forms now cap their height and scroll
  inside themselves instead of running off the bottom of the screen, and the help
  pop-up no longer overflows a narrow viewport.
- **Search and pagination bars wrap.** The controls above and below list tables
  now wrap onto a second line on narrow screens instead of overflowing.
- **Date-range picker fits on a phone.** The calendar pop-out stacks its presets
  above the calendar and stays within the screen width on small devices.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- Desktop layout and behaviour are unchanged.
